title: He Said - She Said — VOA Level 2 Lesson 3
title_ar: قال هو وقالت هي — درس VOA 3
source_credit: Original VOA Learning English Level 2 Lesson 3. WorldVoice presents selected excerpts with Arabic learning translations, not the complete original transcript. Full conversation appears on the linked VOA lesson page; WorldVoice is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.text: You two are late -- exactly 43 minutes late! What happened?
dialogue.translation_ar: لقد تأخرتما، بالتحديد 43 دقيقة! ماذا حدث؟

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: He had to get his "special" coffee -- SPECIAL coffee!
dialogue.translation_ar: كان عليه شراء قهوته «الخاصة»! قهوته الخاصة جدًا!
